PAGE TITLE: Message from the Chief Financial Officer

PHOTOS:
- Margaret Vo Schaus, Chief Financial Officer, smiling in a circular portrait with caption "Sincerely, Margaret Vo Schaus"

KEY FACTS:
- Financial Section date: November 15, 2024
- 14th consecutive year of an unmodified "clean" opinion on NASA's financial statements from the FY 2024 Auditors' report
- Goal I: Ensure stewardship of the taxpayer's investment entrusted to NASA to advance and achieve the Agency's strategic goals, priorities, and missions
- Goal II: Lead and develop a robust analytical community and capability that supports and empowers the Agency mission
- Goal III: Develop and engage the Enterprise workforce to enable the NASA of the future
- FY 2024 Agency Financial Report page number: 46
